snippet.title: Steam Reveal Trailer | Half-Life: Cross Product Multiplayer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3416640/HalfLife_Cross_Product_Multiplayer/
Welcome to the chaos of Cross Product Multiplayer (ZAMNHLMP); a fast-paced multiplayer, inspired by Arena Shooters & Culture of the early 21ST Century, which blends familiar mechanics from Half-Life with new challenges and advantages, with more and more coming each year through our annual season updates. 

Explore the collection of maps, and adaptive gamemodes including but not limited to Capture the Flag, 1v1 Arena, Snipers, One In the Chamber, Arcade, and more.

Based on open-source technologies, ZAMNHLMP is welcoming for familiars and casual players alike.

We originally released this Mod in April 2020 under Early Access, but now, it's coming to Steam. A wider audience - more opponents.

Find your nemesis today in the arena of Cross Product Multiplayer. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3416640

© 2025 The Phoenix Project Software SVG.

This trailer contains an original score by Sabian Roberts. youtube.com/@UCtYXxcsqCCof77QE1p4Btqg
